purpose: Per-lane Apify actor settings for third-party scrapes of public customer-review and community pages. Used by scripts/evidence_scout/providers/apify_actor.py. Only public pages: no logins, cookies or credentialed proxies are ever configured. Customer-evidence spend is pre-authorized (approval_required false) but every run is item-capped.

software_reviews.pricing_basis: PAY_PER_EVENT review-scraped 0.0012 USD (FREE tier); product rows disabled. 599 runs, last run 2026-10-30.
software_reviews.known_limits: Capterra serves a block page to datacentre addresses and needs a residential proxy, which this repo does not configure: Capterra URLs are unsupported. TrustRadius verified live 2026-10-30; Software Advice and GetApp URLs are accepted by the actor but were not live-checked. This actor exposes no vendor-reply field (vendor_reply_field null); map one to the vendor_reply target if a future actor returns it.

g2_reviews.pricing_basis: PAY_PER_EVENT review_scraped 0.00649 USD (tiered) plus 0.00005 actor start. The actor returns at least 10 reviews per request.
g2_reviews.known_limits: G2 terms prohibit automated access; the scrape is third-party and may break or be blocked. Minimum 10 reviews per call, min_items_per_call is 10, so cap math, cost estimate and charge ceiling count 10 items even when --limit is lower. This actor exposes no vendor-reply field (vendor_reply_field null); map one to the vendor_reply target if a future actor returns it.

shopify_app_reviews.pricing_basis: PAY_PER_EVENT review-scraped 0.002 USD plus 0.001 actor start; platform/proxy usage observed about 0.07 USD for a 3-review run (fixed_cost_per_run_usd). App detail rows (0.005 each) are disabled.
shopify_app_reviews.known_limits: Reviews carry no review id; the collector derives a stable id from URL and text. Merchant store names are redacted from fixtures and not retained in author_context. This actor exposes no vendor-reply field (vendor_reply_field null); map one to the vendor_reply target if a future actor returns it.

quora.pricing_basis: PAY_PER_EVENT outputRecord 0.00099 USD. The actor rejects a per-run charge cap below 1.00 USD, so the item cap is the effective limit.
quora.known_limits: Answers are self-selected and often vendor self-promotion (only a coarse has_professional_credential flag is retained, never the credential text). Quora terms restrict automated access. This actor exposes no vendor-reply field (vendor_reply_field null); map one to the vendor_reply target if a future actor returns it.

facebook_public_groups.pricing_basis: PAY_PER_EVENT post 0.005 USD plus 0.001 actor start (official Apify actor, 6.8M runs). Billed per post; top comments ride on the post item.
facebook_public_groups.known_limits: Public groups only; private groups are never attempted and there is no cookie or login option. Only the posts' top comments are returned. Meta terms restrict automated access. This actor exposes no vendor-reply field (vendor_reply_field null); map one to the vendor_reply target if a future actor returns it.
